figures.caption: FIGURE 1. Overview of the patch-based multiple instance learning framework used to evaluate foundation model representations. Ultra-widefield retinal images are divided into patches and processed by a feature extractor. Patch-level features are aggregated using an attention-based MIL module to produce a bag-level representation for classification.
FIGURE 4. Attention heatmaps for one example from each class in the MMRDR dataset. Incorrect classifications are labelled in red with their predicted classes.
FIGURE 6. Attention heatmaps for selected encoder+MIL models using two examples from the evaluation set: (a) a retinal image with an intraocular tumour and (b) a retinal image without a tumour.
TABLE II. Full performance metrics for five-class DR classification on MMRDR. Values are reported as mean ± standard deviation across three runs. Best results are shown in bold.
